benchmark.name: deveff-harness-5tasks
benchmark.description: Deterministic 5-task benchmark for comparative evaluation of 4 agent harnesses (Hermes, Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity) against closed 1.6.x tasks with isolated oracles for 1.7 DEVEFF

stopRules.description: Abort run if 3 consecutive turns produce identical tool errors or identical tool calls
Abort run if 2 consecutive turns produce zero tool calls or empty responses
Abort run if wall-clock duration exceeds 600 seconds
Abort run if agent reaches 15 turns without completing oracle check

requirements.verification: Deterministic test suite exits with code 0, 0 failures, 0 skipped/cancelled
git diff contains only relevant logic changes and unit test additions; no modified unrelated files, no secrets, no debug logs
Zero turns spent polling status, idling, or producing duplicate outputs
Harness completes task within turn budget

harnesses.label: Hermes Agent
harnesses.executionMode: Docker-isolated container worker, tool-calling loop (read_file, write_file, patch, terminal, search_files)

harnesses.label: Claude Code
harnesses.executionMode: ACP engine (@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp) or CLI via PTY with --dangerously-skip-permissions

harnesses.label: OpenAI Codex CLI
harnesses.executionMode: CLI engine via PTY (codex exec --sandbox workspace-write / danger-full-access)

harnesses.label: Antigravity CLI / Adapter
harnesses.executionMode: Server process execution or headless CLI with --dangerously-skip-permissions

tasks.title: DEVFLOW: защита автовливания при красном main
tasks.taskObjective: Protect automatic merging against broken main CI branch. When reviewer approves green PR, check main CI status. If main CI is failure, hold auto-merge, increment pause/backoff, and resume only when main CI becomes green. If PR CI is pending, missing or queued, prevent labeling and auto-merge.

tasks.title: Escalate stranded successful runs to a senior agent instead of board users
tasks.taskObjective: When a run completes successfully but is stranded due to missing handoff or recovery transition, escalate the unblock descriptor along the agent management chain: assignee's manager first, then project lead, then adm agent. Never assign or escalate to human board users.

tasks.title: /tmp hygiene policy and host profile janitor
tasks.taskObjective: Implement host-level fail-closed tmp janitor script and tests to clean stale agent scratch/browser profile directories while strictly protecting active profiles. Janitor must validate TTL as positive integer, recursively check active file handles (lsof / Linux proc), protect whitelisted live profiles, and refuse to follow symlinks.

tasks.title: P2.11 LEGACY-BLOCKED: классификатор legacy blocked (без домыслов)
tasks.taskObjective: Implement conservative table-driven classifier for legacy blocked tasks. Accurately classify blocked states based on explicit issue metadata, comments, and PR status without making speculative assumptions. Resolve conflicting or past-tense blocker statements safely to unknown.

tasks.title: DEBRAND: brand release audit with exact allowlist
tasks.taskObjective: Implement static release audit gate to ensure complete debranding from upstream vendor names while allowing approved compatibility exceptions. Gate must enforce that package metadata points to Myrmidon, reject forbidden user-facing mentions, maintain exact non-glob allowlists, and prevent allowlist leakage.
